text: {"lessons":["Selling at a gain feels satisfying, but I should not sell solely to lock in a profit; I should weigh each holding's outlook and role in my portfolio.","My repeated sales of Stock B and Stock E reduced my exposure, so I should check whether trims fit a deliberate allocation plan rather than reacting to gains.","I should judge decisions by their effect on the whole portfolio and its risk, not just by whether a trade realizes a gain or avoids the pain of a loss."]}
